action.description: The action to perform: create (-c), list (-t), or extract (-x).

filename.description: The filename to use for creation, listing, or extraction.

compression.description: Specifies the compression type: none, gzip, bzip2, lzma.

compression_level.description: Compression level integer between 0 and 9 for gzip, bzip2, or lzma.

extract_dir.description: On extract, xar will chdir to the specified path before extracting.

toc_cksum.description: Hashing algorithm for xml header verification: md5, sha1, sha256, sha512.

file_cksum.description: Hashing algorithm for file content verification: md5, sha1, sha256, sha512.

rsize.description: Size in bytes for the internal libxar read buffer.

exclude_patterns.description: POSIX regex patterns of files to exclude from adding or extracting. Uses items field for pattern details if needed, but here flat list of strings is sufficient for shell args.

no_compress_patterns.description: POSIX regex patterns of files to archive but not compress.

stay_local.description: On archival, stay on the local device (-l).

set_ownership_uid.description: On extract, set ownership based on uid/gid (-P).

set_ownership_symbolic.description: On extract, set ownership based on symbolic names (-p).

keep_existing.description: Does not overwrite existing files during extraction (-k).

coalesce_heap.description: When multiple files are identical, only store one copy of data (--coalesce-heap).

link_same.description: When data sections are identical, hardlink them within the archive (--link-same).

keep_setuid.description: Preserve setuid/setgid bits even if uid/gid differs (--keep-setuid).

prop_include.description: List of file properties to include in the archive (--prop-include). Only these properties will be included.

prop_exclude.description: List of file properties to exclude from the archive (--prop-exclude).

distribution_safe.description: Creates an archive to only contain file properties safe for file distribution (--distribution).
